subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and expose media from unmentioned requireMention group messages to later mentioned turns, and under what TTL, media-type, sender/group access, and storage limits?
rationale: Current source makes the bug clear, but changing it alters a privacy-sensitive boundary for group media that users did not explicitly address to the bot.

options.title: Implement bounded retention
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement local-only, TTL-limited image retention through HistoryEntry.media with access checks and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Document intentional non-retention
options.body: If unmentioned media must never be retained, document that limitation and close the behavior as a deliberate Telegram security choice.

options.title: Narrow to explicit replies
options.body: Allow historical media only when the later turn explicitly replies to the media message, reducing ambient group-history exposure.

recommendation.title: Implement bounded retention
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement local-only, TTL-limited image retention through HistoryEntry.media with access checks and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on skipping unmentioned Telegram group media before download is the closest current-main ownership signal for this boundary.
